answer: Sybil resistance rests on per-identity locked capital, not account counts. Each worker wanting status as a distinct actor must stake capital in a contract it cannot withdraw alone. Free keys make counts worthless; at-risk stake is the real identity unit. N fakes mean N lockups, each slashable for fraud. An attacker wanting influence must idle that capital all game and lose it on each caught identity: forgery is an inventory problem. Payouts stay under one puppet's cost, so fakes go negative, while honest operators get an inlet of demand and a harbor of audited history, no walnut of trust.
